You can be your dog's hero!  We share tips, training, and fun stuff to make life better for you and your dog!

I am a dog trainer and border collie (and many other breed) lover who continually learns and practices new skills. I believe that the dog in front of you has a lot to teach you. 

My dogs have had health issues (epilepsy is one) and behavior challenges (including severe separation anxiety), so I've learned about effective, science based forms of dog training. Your dog, whether sweet, excitable, mischievous or extra smart,  has something to teach you. A challenging dog challenges us to learn more! I hope this dog vlog inspires you to understand and interact more with your amazing dog!
